info.title: Bunkai TMS API
info.description: Bunkai TMS public API. Wraps Supabase auth, ATC authoring, and run execution behind a versioned `/api/v1` surface. Designed to be operated by humans, scripts, CI/CD, and AI agents.

tags.name: Tokens
tags.description: Personal access token issuance and revocation.

bearerAuth.description: Personal access token. Format: `bk_pat_<12-char-prefix>.<base64url-secret>`. Issue via `POST /api/v1/tokens`.

cookieAuth.name: sb-fmbpikzpkafptqximhxn-auth-token
cookieAuth.description: Supabase session cookie. Set automatically after the magic-link callback in the web app. Used for browser-driven calls.

code.description: Machine-readable error code. Branch on this value, not on `message`.

details.description: Optional structured details. For validation errors this is the ZodError issues array.

request_id.description: Echoed `x-request-id`. Quote this in bug reports.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Canonical error envelope returned by every `/api/v1` route on failure.

next.description: Root-relative path to land on after the OTP exchange. Defaults to `/projects`.

token.description: Raw PAT in the form `bk_pat_<prefix>.<secret>`. Shown ONCE in this response. The server only stores SHA-256(secret).

warning.example: Store this token now — it cannot be retrieved later.

name.description: Human-readable label shown in the token-management UI.

scopes.description: Scopes granted to this token. At least one required.

workspace_id.description: Restrict the token to a single workspace. Omit for cross-workspace tokens.

expires_in_days.description: TTL in days. Omit for non-expiring tokens. Max 365.

token_prefix.description: First 12 chars of the secret. Safe to display.

name.description: 3–80 chars, at least one alphanumeric. Slug is auto-derived.

warning.description: Present only when the resulting nesting depth is >= 5.

name.description: 2–80 chars, at least one alphanumeric. Path segment is auto-derived.

parent_module_id.description: Parent module id; omit for a root module. Must belong to the same project.

name.description: New name, 2–80 chars, at least one alphanumeric. Renaming rebuilds the module path and every descendant path.

description.description: New description (max 500 chars). Pass null to clear it; omit to leave it unchanged.

parent_module_id.description: Move the module: a UUID re-parents it under that module (carrying its subtree); null moves it to the project root; omit to leave the parent unchanged. Rejects cycles, depth > 6, and cross-project targets.

archived.description: Per-table counts of rows archived by the cascade.

description.description: Optional Markdown, up to 50 KB. Sanitized on save.

external_id.description: Optional Jira key (LETTERS-NUMBER, e.g. BK-42). Unique per project, case-insensitive.

description.description: Markdown, up to 50 KB; null clears it.

external_id.description: Jira key. Immutable once set — a change returns 409.

status.description: Ready-to-test gate: moving to ready_to_test with zero active acceptance criteria returns 409 (BK-15).

description.description: Optional Markdown, up to 50 KB. Sanitized on save.

position.description: 1-based insert position; appended at the tail when omitted. Active siblings shift down atomically.

description.description: Markdown, up to 50 KB; null clears it.

position.description: 1-based target position. The active set is re-numbered contiguously around it (no gaps).

jql.description: Jira JQL. Issues are imported into the project; components route to Modules by name (else Inbox).

post.description: Server-side wrapper around `supabase.auth.signInWithOtp`. Sends a one-time link to the supplied email. Public — no auth required.

429.description: Supabase OTP rate limit hit (free tier: 4/hour/email).

post.description: Password sign-in for CLI / agent callers. Returns the Supabase session AND a freshly-minted Bearer PAT in a single response so the caller can immediately authenticate subsequent requests without a browser.

Provisions a user via the Supabase admin API with `email_confirm: true` so no email click is required, then signs them in and mints a PAT. Intended for QA / CLI environments — production sign-up should still use the magic-link path.

get.description: Returns service identity, current environment, and a server timestamp. Always public.
Discovery endpoint that points clients (CLI, agents, browsers) at the OpenAPI spec and the Scalar docs UI. Public.

post.description: Issuance is session-authenticated — a logged-in user mints PATs via the web app. PATs cannot mint other PATs (chicken-and-egg). The raw secret is returned exactly once.

201.description: Token created. Capture the `token` field — it is unrecoverable.

get.description: Returns every PAT the calling user owns, without the secret hash. RLS enforces ownership.

delete.description: Soft-delete: sets `revoked_at = now()` so the row stays in the audit trail. The bearer middleware rejects revoked rows.

404.description: Token not found or already revoked.

post.description: Caller must be signed in. Caller email must match invite email. Adds membership in the invite's workspace + role; stamps acceptance on the invite.

403.description: Invite email does not match caller.

post.summary: Set the active workspace for the current session
post.description: Validates membership, then sets the `bk_active_ws` httpOnly cookie. Supabase JWT is untouched.

403.description: Caller is not a member of the target workspace.

get.description: Returns the signed-in user, all workspaces they belong to, and the selected active workspace (driven by the bk_active_ws cookie).

post.summary: Create workspace + auto-enrol caller as owner
post.description: Wraps the `bunkai_bootstrap_workspace` SECURITY DEFINER RPC so the workspace row and the owner-membership row are inserted in a single transaction.

get.summary: List workspaces the caller belongs to
get.description: RLS-filtered list of every workspace where the caller has an active membership.

404.description: Workspace not found or not visible.

patch.description: Owner-only. Today only `name` is mutable; slug rotation is post-MVP.

post.description: Admin/owner only. Generates a one-time token; returns the raw token + accept_url in the body. MVP does not send an email — share the URL out-of-band.

get.description: RLS limits results to admins/owners of the workspace.

post.description: Generates a new secret + extends expiry by 7 days. Clears any prior acceptance/revocation. Admin/owner only via RLS.

404.description: Invite not found or no permission.
Invite not found or no permission.

post.summary: Create a project in a workspace
post.description: Member-only (role >= member). Auto-derives a per-workspace-unique slug from the name. Duplicate slug returns 409; non-members return 403.

400.description: Malformed workspace id or invalid JSON body.

403.description: Caller is not a member of the workspace.

409.description: A project with this slug already exists in the workspace.

post.summary: Create a module in a project
post.description: Member-only (role >= member). Auto-derives a per-parent-unique path segment from the name. Modules nest up to 6 levels; depth >= 5 returns a soft warning, depth > 6 is rejected. Duplicate sibling path returns 409; non-members return 403.

400.description: Malformed project id or invalid JSON body.

403.description: Caller is not a member of the project.

409.description: A module with this name already exists under the same parent.

422.description: Validation failed (name, description, depth, or parent).

patch.summary: Rename, edit, or move a module
patch.description: Member-only (role >= member). Renaming rebuilds the module path and every descendant path; `parent_module_id` moves the module (and its subtree) to a new parent or the project root. A sibling/destination slug collision returns 409; a cycle, depth-overflow, or invalid target returns 422. An archived module reads as 404. Viewers/non-members return 403.

400.description: Malformed module id or invalid JSON body.

403.description: Caller is not a member of the project.

409.description: The new name or move destination collides with a sibling module.

422.description: Validation failed (name, description, or move: cycle / depth / invalid parent).

delete.summary: Soft-delete (archive) a module and its subtree
delete.description: Member-only (role >= member). Archives the module, its descendant modules, and the linked user stories, acceptance criteria, and ATCs in one transaction. Returns per-table counts. Archiving an already-archived module returns 409; viewers/non-members return 403.

403.description: Caller is not a member of the project.

post.summary: Create a user story under a module
post.description: Member-only. Anchors the story to the module, validates the title (3–200) and optional Jira key, sanitizes the Markdown description. Duplicate Jira key in the project returns 409.

409.description: Jira key already linked in this project.

422.description: Validation failed (title, Jira key, or description size).

get.summary: List a module's active user stories
get.description: Member-only. Returns active (non-archived) stories, newest first.

patch.description: Member-only. Title / description / Jira key. The Jira key is immutable once set (409 on change).

409.description: Duplicate/immutable Jira key, or ready-to-test gate (no active acceptance criteria).

post.summary: Add an acceptance criterion to a user story
post.description: Member-only. Inserts at the given position (or the tail), atomically shifting active siblings down so positions stay gap-free.

get.summary: List a story's active acceptance criteria
get.description: Member-only. Returns active (non-archived) criteria in position order.

patch.summary: Edit or reorder an acceptance criterion
patch.description: Member-only. Edits title/detail (direct update) and/or moves position (atomic, gap-free re-number).

delete.description: Member-only. Archives the criterion, closes the position gap, and drops the parent story out of ready_to_test when it was the last active criterion (user_story_reverted).

post.description: Member-only. Enqueues a one-way Jira import for the project and processes it in the background; idempotent on re-run. At most one active import per project (409). Returns immediately with the job id.

409.description: An import is already running for this project.

get.description: Member-only. Returns the job status (queued | running | completed | failed) plus per-run counts and per-issue errors.
